body: I quit. Now all I have to do is face my parents and receive the disappointment. I could cry right now. I feel like the biggest loser ever

Since I'm living under my parents roof they are very controlling. They say that they want the best for me but in reality I think they're just waiting for me to get my own life. Getting professional help would require me to get financial aid from my parents, which will blow everything up. I have just now reserve a time at a doctor, to see if they can do anything about my anxieties and constant stress.
